_comment: SD pre-reduce EWL — OFF BYTE-IDENTITY arm (standing invariant #6).
Identical to _golden0729_net50_30ep_wl1off.json in EVERY functional key, including
eigen_threads / parallel_max_threads = 8: the only difference is where the product
file lands, so the artifacts must match runs/golden_0729/net50_wl1off/ byte for byte.
Why this arm is required and not merely nice: this card touched a SHARED path.
MwSlipDetector::MwArcStats gained code1/code2, processMwSample gained two trailing
code parameters, and arcZdMean now serves exists/code1/code2.  All of it is
bookkeeping (the MW value arrives pre-computed), so it MUST be arithmetically inert
— and 'must be' is an argument, not a measurement.  Same-build comparison only:
verification integers are build-config sensitive at the ppm level.
